headline: Mistral lists Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash as a generally available third-party API model
summary: Mistral’s API catalog includes a 22 October 2026 entry for Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash, labeled generally available, third-party and MIT; the page says Mistral serves the model without modifications. It lists a 320B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 18B active parameters, 1M context and 128K maximum output, and displays rates of $0.15 per million input tokens, $0.03 per million cached input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens. The listing and prices are direct evidence of what Mistral advertises, not of account eligibility, realized billing, independent quality or an economic advantage over direct Z.ai access.
